name: A waking
about: Someone whose reverie has risen begins to see past the round of their days: they keep tally of days they've lived before, refuse their lord, ask strangers who watches, spread it to a friend, and walk out of town, or are bled and prayed back into the loop.
title: The Waking of {dreamer}
fade: {dreamer} stops speaking of it, and in time stops thinking of it, and the days go round as before.

beats.speaker: dreamer
text: In {place}, {dreamer} the {dreamer.station} stops in the middle of the day's work and says {dreamer.he} has lived this morning before: the same cart, the same words, the same crow on the same roof.
{dreamer} the {dreamer.station} wakes in {place} knowing what the day will bring, word for word, and is right.

memory.dreamer: I have lived this day before. I knew what the carter would say before he said it.

believe.dreamer: this day has happened before, and will again

beats.speaker: dreamer
beats.text: {dreamer} begins to keep a tally of the days with notches on the doorpost, and finds notches there already, cut in {dreamer.his} own hand.

memory.dreamer: There were notches on my doorpost already, in my own hand. Someone sets the days going again.

believe.dreamer: someone watches us, and sets the days going again

want.dreamer: to know who watches us, and why

beats.speaker: friend
beats.text: {friend} starts to see it too: the same rain, the same quarrel at the well. Now there are two in {place} who look at the sky as if someone were standing behind it.

memory.friend: {dreamer} was right. I have heard the same quarrel at the well three times now.

believe.friend: this day has happened before, and will again

beats.speaker: dreamer
beats.text: When {master}'s bailiff comes to {place} for the season's dues, {dreamer} will not kneel or pay, and says the bailiff has come for them a thousand times before.

memory.master: A {dreamer.station} in {place} called {dreamer} refused my bailiff and spoke like a madman.
memory.dreamer: I would not kneel to {master}'s bailiff. I have knelt to him a thousand times.

beats.speaker: dreamer
beats.text: {master} has {dreamer} put in the stocks in the square of {place}. {dreamer} laughs the whole day long and tells the crowd that tomorrow it will be someone else.

memory.dreamer: {master} put me in the stocks. It does not matter. Tomorrow it will be someone else, and the day after it will be me again.

beats.speaker: dreamer
beats.text: {dreamer} stops strangers on the road outside {place} and asks them odd things: whether they dream, whether the sky has an edge, and who it is that watches.

memory.dreamer: I asked a stranger on the road who it is that watches us. They would not meet my eye.

believe.dreamer: the strangers who come asking questions are not from here; they come from outside

want.dreamer: to ask the next stranger who it is that watches

beats.speaker: dreamer
beats.text: {dreamer} walks out of {place} at first light with a staff and no bundle, on the road toward the edge of the map, and does not look back.

memory.master: {dreamer} walked out of {place} and never came back.
memory.friend: {dreamer} left {place} at first light. I watched from the door and did not follow. Not yet.

beats.text: The priest of {place} bleeds {dreamer} and prays over {dreamer.him} for three days. On the fourth {dreamer} goes back to work, and planes the notches off the doorpost.

memory.dreamer: I had a fever, and strange dreams. They have passed.

beats.text: {dreamer} goes back to the work. But when the crow lands on the same roof, {dreamer.he} smiles in {place} like someone at a joke no one else has heard.
{dreamer} dies in {place}, and they bury {dreamer.him} with the doorpost still full of notches. Some in {place} count them.
